flags.why: This elevated, literary adjective is untagged and could be mistaken for an ordinary conversational word.
The example defines the headword instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Sa hoàng ra lệnh cho quân đội rút lui. = The tsar ordered the army to retreat.

flags.why: Kiếm chác means seeking or making personal gains and does not necessarily involve dishonesty.
flags.fix: to make some money; to seek personal gain

flags.why: Using autism to describe ordinary withdrawal or brooding can be offensive, but the sense lacks a warning tag.
The example explains the avoidance term instead of using it to refer to a snake.
flags.fix: Dân làng không dám động đến ông lốt. = The villagers dared not touch the snake.

flags.why: This disparaging expression accuses someone of sponging off others and needs a derogatory warning.
